company.name: EPLEHUSET AS
company.summary: EPLEHUSET AS is a private limited company (aksjeselskap) registered under detaljhandel med informasjons- og kommunikasjonsteknologiutstyr (NACE 47.400), based in Trondheim, founded 2000-01-23. Its verified website describes it as: “Norges største Apple Premium Partner. Det beste stedet å oppleve Apple sine produkter i Norge, med butikker over hele landet, sertifiserte reparasjoner og tilpassede løsninger for bedrifter. Handle enkelt med rask levering.” Public brand: Eplehuset. Registered activity: Målgruppen er: Privatpersoner, studenter, skoler, universiteter, høgskoler og institusjoner. a) Utvikle et spennende butikk-konsept med fokus på Apple teknologi og tilbehør samt annet tilleggsutstyr fra andre leverandører. b) Fremme bruken av Mac OS blandt den ovennevnte målgrupp. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue NOK 68.5 m, operating result NOK 4.1 m, net result NOK 4.0 m, total assets NOK 64.3 m, equity NOK 53.4 m. The period closed with a profit. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from NOK 66.7 m to NOK 68.5 m (+3%); net result went from NOK 4.2 m to NOK 4.0 m (-5%); equity went from NOK 49.3 m to NOK 53.4 m (+8%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin 5.9%; equity ratio 83.0%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 36. Leadership in the official register: Espen Andreas Berger (managing director); Fredrik Tønnesen (chair of the board); Lill Beate Pedersen (board member); Christine Hundsnes (board member); plus 3 further roles. 1 registered workplace in Trondheim. Official website https://www.eplehuset.no (identity check: registry declared homepage); company-linked profiles on facebook, instagram, linkedin, youtube. Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-07-15). Not established from checked sources: active job ads (not available). Missing information is not treated as zero.
